description: Start a drawing, run drafting commands and render it.

identity.goal: Complete the create drawing use case of cadcraft using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the cadcraft upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `cadcraft` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced cadcraft_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `cadcraft_new_drawing`, `cadcraft_list_commands`, `cadcraft_execute`, `cadcraft_render`. Steps: (1) Start the drawing in the requested units. (2) Look up the drafting commands. (3) Run the commands. (4) Render the drawing to verify. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace cadcraft was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
